stories.title: Trump Orders Reduced South Korea Military Exercises, Citing Friendship with Kim Jong-un
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump announced on Sunday night that he has ordered a substantial reduction in the scale of "Ulchi Freedom Shield," annual joint military exercises with South Korea. The drills were expected to begin on Monday, but Trump directed Secretary of War Pete Hegseth to cut back their scope.

The decision was framed around diplomatic engagement rather than security concerns alone. Trump cited his “very good relationship” with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and said that talking to Kim makes South Korea safer.

Al Jazeera reported that Kim has responded “very positively” to the approach, while BBC World described the move as a notable shift in US posture toward both Koreas.

stories.summary:

The decision marks a second legal setback for Trump in the case involving allegations of sexual abuse from 1996 and subsequent defamation claims.

Trump had previously been ordered to pay more than $5 million in damages, which he has already settled.

stories.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere Dead At 36
stories.summary:
Actress Hayden Panettiere has died at the age of 36. A representative confirmed the news on Sunday in a statement shared with ABC News, describing her as "beloved" and expressing profound sadness over her passing.

Panettiere was best known for her roles in the NBC drama Heroes and the television series Nashville. She also appeared in the Scream franchise.

Tributes have emerged following the announcement of her death. A coroner's report indicated there were no signs of trauma, according to BBC reporting.

stories.summary:

The comments came as a 60-day memorandum of understanding with Iran expired on Monday. The president warned that if Oman gets in the way of American operations in the region, “we’ll bomb the sh*t out of them.”

stories.title: Trump approval sinks to new low as voters fear prolonged Iran war: Poll
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 33%, a new low for the Republican president, according to a Reuters-Ipsos poll released Monday.

The survey found that voters are increasingly worried about the potential duration of the U.S. conflict with Iran. This concern contributed to a two-point drop in his approval compared to an earlier survey conducted by the same pollster this month.

Trump’s current rating reflects a 31-point difference, underscoring the political impact of the ongoing geopolitical tensions.

stories.title: Trump indicates US won’t seek memorandum of understanding extension following conclusion of 60-day ceasefire
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump indicated on Monday that the United States will not seek an extension of the memorandum of understanding with Iran after its 60-day ceasefire expired. The agreement, reached in June, was intended to allow both sides to negotiate a permanent end to the war, but no long-term deal was finalized before the deadline.

Speaking from the Oval Office, Trump said Iran should “put up the white flag of surrender,” according to Al Jazeera. The outlet also reported that the U.S. claims control of the Strait of Hormuz as tensions remain high following the lapse of the ceasefire framework.

stories.title: One Nation wants to restrict migration. A town in Barnaby Joyce's electorate welcomes it – video
stories.summary:
Armidale, a New South Wales city in Barnaby Joyce’s electorate, has operated as a designated refugee resettlement site since 2018. The town’s experience contrasts with the migration policies now promoted by Joyce after his move from the Nationals to One Nation.

Joyce was previously a key supporter of Armidale’s role in resettling refugees. He later joined One Nation, which advocates for restrictions on migrants who do not speak English.

Guardian Australia reporter Adeshola Ore visited Armidale to discuss these developments with Joyce and local community members.

stories.title: YouTube is changing how it counts views to give the numbers a boost
stories.summary:
YouTube is changing how it counts views to give the numbers a boost. The platform will soon count a view as soon as a video starts to play, aligning its methodology with systems used by Instagram and TikTok.

This update brings standard long-form videos in line with YouTube Shorts, which adopted this counting approach a year ago. By registering views at the start of playback rather than after a minimum watch time, creators may see higher view counts across their channels.

stories.summary:

The temperature decline could be more than 15C compared with last Thursday's peak heat. As conditions become unsettled, some areas of the UK may see temperatures fall about 3C below normal by Thursday.

stories.title: ‘I see the incredible promise’: on set of an AI film shoot as new studios embrace controversial tech
stories.summary:
A new AI-focused film studio called Promise has opened near Sony Pictures’ historic Culver City lot, positioning itself as a tech-powered alternative to traditional major studios. The development comes amid ongoing debate over artificial intelligence’s role in filmmaking and its potential impact on industry jobs.

Some filmmakers involved with the project argue that AI tools could lower production barriers, allowing independent creators to bypass established studio gatekeepers and pursue more experimental work. Critics, however, remain concerned about labor displacement and the broader implications of replacing traditional production methods with algorithmic processes.

Critics note that the secrecy surrounding the framework represents a significant lack of transparency in how potentially dangerous AI systems will be vetted. By withholding details from public view, the process may inadvertently benefit secretive AI companies rather than ensuring broad accountability for emerging technological risks.

stories.summary:
The Philippine National Police (PNP) has mobilized additional personnel and vehicles to assist commuters stranded by heavy rains in Metro Manila and other affected areas. The deployment aims to ferry passengers who are unable to secure public transportation due to flooding caused by the persistent southwest monsoon, or habagat.

According to the state weather bureau, the habagat is expected to continue prevailing over parts of Luzon and Visayas on Tuesday. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) forecast that these conditions will bring monsoon winds and occasional rains to the regions.

The coalition also cautioned that the absence of tracking technology may affect the Philippines' access to major seafood export markets. This support underscores concerns among stakeholders about maintaining compliance with international standards and protecting domestic fisheries.

stories.title: Abra de Ilog in Occidental Mindoro evacuates families as river overflows
stories.summary:
Authorities in Calapan City, Oriental Mindoro, evacuated families from a flood-prone community after the Abra de Ilog river overflowed. The evacuations were carried out amid continued heavy rains on Tuesday, August 18.

The Abra de Ilog Emergency Response Operations (AERO) coordinated with the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office to manage the situation. Personnel from the Bureau of Fire Protection also assisted in the emergency response efforts.

stories.title: The Latest Gaza Hostages Freed: Women Whose Hamas Warnings Were Ignored
stories.summary:
Four women held as hostages in Gaza are set to be released after a swap involving soldiers stationed at the Nahal Oz border crossing. The release follows 15 months of captivity and sustained advocacy by their families.

The Wall Street Journal notes that warnings from Hamas regarding these specific individuals were previously ignored. Their eventual freedom marks a significant development in the ongoing hostage negotiations.

stories.title: Spotify’s new Playlist Notes let users and editors explain their song picks
stories.summary:
Spotify has introduced Playlist Notes, a new feature that allows users and editors to explain the stories behind their song selections. The update gives listeners a chance to share the reasoning and context for their favorite music.

Editors will also use the tool on major playlists such as RapCaviar. This addition aims to provide more depth to curated listening experiences.

stories.title: Sainsbury’s store pauses AI scanning after false shoplifting accusation
stories.summary:
Sainsbury’s has paused the use of AI face scanning in one of its stores after a customer was wrongly identified as a shoplifter and ejected from the premises.

The supermarket chain attributed the incident to “human error” rather than its Facewatch technology. The affected customer, Matt Arnold, 46, described feeling embarrassed, humiliated, and powerless during the ordeal.

stories.title: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
stories.summary:
Beijing has signaled a willingness to engage with the incoming Trump administration, including officials who have previously taken hardline stances against China.

The Chinese foreign minister recently held a phone conversation with Marco Rubio, the new U.S. Secretary of State. This dialogue is notable given that Rubio has been a vocal critic of Beijing in the past.

stories.title: Trump Says Colombia Will Accept Deportees, Ending Tariff Standoff
stories.summary:
President Trump said Colombia will accept deportation flights, ending a tariff standoff between the two countries. The announcement comes as immigration enforcement has become an early priority for his second term.

The White House framed the development as a resolution to recent tensions over repatriation logistics and trade policy. Meanwhile, federal agents continued aggressive operations domestically, with ICE making more than 900 arrests on Sunday.
